WHAT: iOS system keyboard (and by extension keyboard extensions) ARE visible in Maestro's accessibility tree when keyboard is shown
DETAILS:
- Individual key labels ('q', 'w', 'e'...) are accessible elements
- Globe key appears as 'Next keyboard'
- After tapping globe, iOS may show 'Quickly Change Keyboards' tutorial that needs 'Continue' dismissal
- Maestro inputText uses its own input method (bypasses visible keyboard) — use tapOn key labels to actually exercise the keyboard UI
GOTCHA: Safari URL bar in iOS 26 uses special input mode that may not show keyboard in hierarchy. Use Whisnap app's search field (History tab > 'Search transcripts') or a loaded web page instead.
LIMITATION: Keyboard extension process is separate — crashes there won't show in main app, but elements DO appear when keyboard is loaded successfully.
